decision: The bundled documentation stylesheet uses a readable font token scale derived from DESIGN.md, with body-sized text at the Notion design brief's body-md size of 1rem and compact labels scaled to remain legible. Generated documentation should prefer readable default prose over an overly dense small-text interface.
name: Increase bundled stylesheet font scale
description: Documents the default documentation font-size token scale so the bundled stylesheet remains readable and aligned with the design brief without project overrides.
